additional_info.subject: ID0484761-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP/RN170002891] Session Energy Discrepancy CRM:03288000549
additional_info.body:
Dear Gabriel ,
I hope this email finds you well.
We could check the video you shared with us and with the time stamp
2026-02-05
when the charger lost the communication, the car was with 59% but the car keep charging because of a delay on the connection that made the charger keep charging until the car reach 61% and the session stopped.
On the screenshot above we can see the charger had 115 kW available to delivery but the car didn't requested power delivery.
On this second screenshot we can see the first time when the car stop to ask power delivery before the charging session stop.
With bes
t regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484761-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP/RN170002891] Session Energy Discrepancy CRM:03288000549
additional_info.body:
Dear Gabriel ,
I hope this email finds you well.
We could check the video you shared with us and with the time stamp
2026-02-05
when the charger lost the communication, the car was with 59% but the car keep charging because of a delay on the connection that made the charger keep charging until the car reach 61% and the session stopped.

The conclusion

With best
regards,
